description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commit notes organization in subtrees. It includes setup functions, test cases for various note pathing schemes, and verification routines for testing the behavior of note storage and retrieval in different fanout structures.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Prepares a commit with a note in refs/notes/commits.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the Git log contains expected notes for all commits.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates commits with notes organized according to SHA-1 path substitution patterns.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Creates commits where multiple path substitution patterns produce identical note paths.

methods.name: test_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Creates commits with concatenated notes stored in different path schemes.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Verifies the presence and content of concatenated notes for commits.
